segments.text: Kirari is the vocalist of the band.

She meets Shikanosuke when she begins working at the restaurant where he works. Her family is very poor, so she works mornings and evenings to make ends meet. However, her cheerful, spontaneous attitude normally masks this hardship. Her disheveled hair and her bright smile are her trademark features.
From Mangagamer
好きなモノ：猫、ハンバーグ、ナポリタンスパゲティ
好きな言葉：「満腹」
バンド内でボーカルを担当する天真爛漫な少女。
家がひどく貧乏で、朝と夜やっているバイト代を
家に入れている勤労少女の一面も。
しかし、そんな苦労のかけらも感じさせない
曇りのない笑顔は、彼女のトレードマーク。
彼女が使っているギターは、旅先で知り合った
ちょっちり強面のお兄さんから譲り受けたものらしい。
前作のヒロイン。第二文芸部のボーカル担当。
学園卒業後はプロのボーカリストとしてデビュー。
国内・海外問わず飛び回る忙しい生活を送っている。
乐队主唱。打工中偶然和鹿之助相识。
家境贫寒，因此而没日没夜的打工来补贴家里，是个勤劳的女孩。
平时不会流露出辛苦样子的天真烂漫的少女；天线头发和阳光的笑容是她的标志性招牌。
Chie is Shikanosuke's childhood friend. She plays the drums.

She is a year older than Shikanosuke, but for family reasons she had to repeat a grade. She is also the president of the Second Literature Club, which Shikanosuke and Sarina are part of. Possibly because of what she has went through, Chie is mature, thoughtful, and acts as the voice of reason for the band. However, she also keeps a tight leash on herself, disguising her laidback and timid nature.
From Mangagamer
好きなモノ：料理、ファッション
好きな言葉：「平和」
鹿之助の幼馴染で、ドラム担当。
家庭の事情で留年しているため、一つ年上。
彼らが所属する「第二文芸部」の部長で、
苦労してきたせいか、大人の考えを持つメンバーのまとめ役。
始めは桶や雑誌を積み上げた“エアードラム”での練習だったが、
同級生でインディースバンドをやっている健太のおかげで、
本物での練習が出来るようになる。
前作のヒロイン。第二文芸部のドラム担当。
卒業後は自身の希望通り、福祉系の職業に就く。
家が近いので、村上や鹿之助とはちょくちょく会っているが、
バンド活動からは身を引いている。
乐队鼓手，鹿之助的青梅竹马。因为家里的原因而留级一年。
绮良里、纱理奈、鹿之助所属的“第二文化部”的部长。
可能是因为费心的缘故，思考方式接近成人，是乐队内的协调者。
也因而有着压抑自己的情况，内里是个懒鬼兼胆小鬼。

Murakami is Shikanosuke's friend and his former partner when he played doubles in the tennis club. He is big and macho but easily gets sentimental. His family owns the alcohol business Murakami Liquor, and he is always seen wearing Murakami Liquor T-shirts. He likes to join in on Go games, and is also in the Go club. While he could not join d2b, he teaches the d2b members about what punk rock is.
After graduation, he forms HAPPY CYCLE MANIA and plays guitar.
From Wikipedia
HAPPY CYCLE MANIA ギター＆ボーカル
前作では主人公・鹿之助の親友として登場。
能天気なポジティブさを遺憾なく発揮した。
ポジティブで能天気な性格は相変わらずだが、最近何かと悩みがち。
Yuuko is the younger sister of Shikanosuke. She follows her brother's footsteps and becomes the bassist and leader of d2b-2 in Curtain Call.
From Wikipedia.
二代目第二文芸部・ベース
欧美学園二年生。前作の主人公・前島鹿之助の妹。
結衣と親友で、宗太たちとは幼なじみ。
宗太曰く、「性格のねじまがった女」。
ひねくれているが、面倒見がよく、仲間思い。
だが、普段はちょっとえらそう。
一言で言うと、女版鹿之助。
そして、こっそりお兄ちゃん子。
元吹奏楽部などの錚々たるメンバーのなか、
第二文芸部バンドベースの地位を手に入れる。
Yagihara is the leader and main vocalist of Star Generation. He discovered d2b's ability and supports them.
From Wikipedia
In Curtain Call he became a producer of Happy Circle Mania and owned the music theater.
インディーズレーベルを立ち上げて、
他のバンドの世話などいろいろやっている。
口ひげを生やしはじめた。
Akira is the vocalist of the Visual kei band Panic in Nagoya. He blames Shikanosuke for his cross-dressing.
In Curtain Call, Akira becomes the guitarist for HAPPY CYCLE MANIA.
From Wikipedia
HAPPY CYCLE MANIA ギター
前作では、名古屋のビジュアル系バンド「Panic」のボーカルとして登場。
東京に出てきた際に村上と意気投合し、ハピマニに参加。
音作りに異様な執念を燃やす。

Jutaro is a martial arts expert who plays the drums for HAPPY CYCLE MANIA. Because his home was a karate dojo, he was trained in the martial arts from a young age. He even has black-belts in Judo and other styles, but for some reason he chose to play the drums. He holds Murakami in high respect.
From MangaGamer official webcite
HAPPY CYCLE MANIA ドラム
ハッピーサイクルマニアのドラム担当。
実家が空手の道場で、武術の達人でもある。
Stubborn girl who Shikanosuke and Kirari saved from molester during their tour.

After watching Kirari perform during the Second Literature Club's tour in Osaka, Aki comes to admire Kirari and decides to begin her own musical career as a vocalist. She joins HAPPY CYCLE MANIA, but leaves to pursue a professional career as a solo artist.
From MangaGamer official website.
ハッピーサイクルマニアの元ボーカル。
最近ソロでプロデビューを果たす。
Kenta's cousin. Okaji plays the keyboard for HAPPY CYCLE MANIA. He is a strange person who only has interest in machines, but his skill is irrefutable. Has quite pretty girlfriend.
From MangaGamer official webcite
HAPPY CYCLE MANIA キーボード
ハピマニのキーボード担当。
機械にしか興味がない変人だが、腕は確か。

Shikanosuke is the protagonist of KiraKira. He used to be in the tennis club with his best friend, Murakami. In the beginning of the story, he gets dumped by his girlfriend and quits the tennis club due to health problems. In the d2b (second literature club) band, he joins as Shikako Maejima, a red-headed girl with hearing problems. This way they can try to become an all girl's band. He plays bass guitar in the band.
From Wikipedia

Miyuki and Mai are members of the second literary club. They purposely don't specify who is who so nobody can tell them apart. When Shikanosuke asks who is who, they call him a pervert. They make d2b's band uniforms.
From Wikipedia
The wife of yakuza Shiraga-gumi's boss in Okayama. She is in conflict with Midori.
From Wikipedia
The former drummer of "HAPPY CYCLE MANIA".
From Wikipedia
He is half Japanese and half foreigner who meets in Okinawa. He is the vocal & guitarist of a local band.

Sarina is the guitarist.

She comes from a wealthy family who funds the academy. Because of her weak constitution and her grandfather's strict upbringing, she has very few friends. As a refined young lady, her behavior is graceful and she possesses a calm demeanor, but her will is strong. She is very good friends with Kirari and considers her irreplaceable.
From MangaGamer

Kenta is Shikanosuke's classmate. He is the guitarist of the well-known band Star Generation in Kirakira, and also coaches d2b. He tends to be frank and cold, but he is passionate when he is talking about music. Chie gave him the nickname "Tonoyan". Shikanosuke called him "poker face."
From Wikipedia

From Wikipedia
Sister Yoshizawa is a teacher at Ohbi Gakuen. While she seems strict, she is an understanding woman.
From Wikipedia
Tomo is the proxy booking manager at Livehouse in Osaka. Although she already had a boyfriend, she still tried to seduce Shikanosuke when they were alone in the theatre.
From Wikipedia
A legendary guitarist living in Kobe. He used to roam the world. Appears only in Chie's route.

A girl Chie and Shikako saved from getting into trouble in Okayama. Appears only in Chie's route .

From Wikipedia
Sarina's uncle. Appears only in Sarina's route.
Son of the wealthy Onda family. He fell in love with Shikako.
